draw_camera_marker: create a trimesh camera marker with a given transform and color for a 3D scene
draw_cameras_from_eyes: build camera markers from eye positions and look-at targets and add them to a trimesh scene
draw_cams_batch: draw multiple camera markers from a batch of world-to-camera transforms into a trimesh scene
draw_mesh_from_sdf: extract a triangular mesh from a signed distance field tensor using marching cubes and color by normals
capture_scene_image: render a trimesh scene from a given camera pose and return the image as a numpy array
